message: Track discovered raw-history privacy release blocker

patch.value: Do not publish a crate or tag a release until a maintainer approves a coordinated author-map rewrite and force-push plan. Preserve tag names and release mapping, recreate annotated tags using approved tagger identities, re-sign recreated tags when signature policy requires it, notify consumers, rerun the full raw-history secret and identity audit, and verify every remote ref after replacement.
